description: Tokens are scattered along a spiral hallway. Collect every one and drop them all on the green goal in the center at (3, 3). Counting every step works, but your sensors can make this much shorter.
hint: Repeat until at_goal(): pick up anything on your tile (object_here()), then move() if front_is_clear(), otherwise turn_left(). At the center, use carries_object() in a loop to put_object() until you are empty. In C++: while (!at_goal()) {  }  In Python: while not at_goal():
